name: yang2swagger
description: YANG to Swagger (OpenAPI Specification) generator producing RESTCONF-compliant API definitions. Handles enums, leafrefs, groupings, and augmentations with model inheritance optimization.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker run command documented: docker run -it -v $(pwd):. yang2swagger <arguments>

eval_notes: Primary tool for generating OpenAPI/Swagger specs from YANG models. Useful for building REST API documentation and client/server stubs from YANG-defined interfaces. Docker support makes it easy to integrate into CI/CD.
